<@1149206585760030730> **I wouldn't move your 3.42 EXL3 setup to the current JJ images yet.** I checked R28 and the newer **R28.1**, rather than treating the Flash results as results for the full model.

Your compose requires `--quantization=exl3`. In the installed runtimes, after loading their plugins:
```
Gilded Gnosis r28 / r34  EXL3 loader available
Jovian Judgement R28    Invalid quantization method: exl3
Jovian Judgement R28.1  Invalid quantization method: exl3
```
That's a missing-loader compatibility blocker, **not a measured speed regression**. These were CPU-only runtime checks; I haven't run a full-model GPU generation benchmark or produced a JJ EXL3 tokens/sec number. I also haven't changed the checkpoint or precision to force a different comparison.

This matches Festr's update that full 5.3's new JJ integration is still to come. Once there's an EXL3-capable JJ build, the useful comparison is your exact model/settings against GG—not another Flash test.
